messages:
aisha_cs: Morning team — heads up: three of our APAC customers asked to move the weekly enablement office hours from 02:00 UTC to something earlier for their teams. Can we trial a 21:00 UTC slot next Wed (Q3 week) instead? Need to confirm facilitator availability and update invites. /cc @priya_enablement

priya_enablement: I can run the first two sessions at 21:00 UTC next Wed. That works for me. Agenda same as usual? :thumbsup:

aisha_cs: Yep — same agenda, but add a short segment on 'dedicated capacity best practices' — 15 mins.

tom_solutions: 21:00 UTC is 04:00+ for me :sleeping: — I can cover Q&A if we record, or swap with Tom T. who prefers late hours. @nico_prod can you take notes for the first session?

nico_prod: happy to take notes and capture action items. I'll post the follow-up doc in #cs-resources afterwards.

onboard-bot: Poll created: https://polls.internal/s/e3f2 — options: 20:00 UTC / 21:00 UTC / 22:00 UTC. Expires in 48h.

priya_enablement: Proposed agenda (short):
```
1) 10m intros + rollout statuses
2) 15m dedicated capacity best practices
3) 20m live Q&A + migration checklist
4) 5m next steps + feedback capture
```

aisha_cs: Nice. Can we add a quick ask: customers to share one migration blocker ahead of time? That'll speed up Q&A.

tom_solutions: +1. I'll add it to the invite and put a pinned sticky in the thread.

aisha_cs: Poll looks good — we'll wait for results. If 21:00 wins I will update calendar invites and enable recording. Thanks all :pray:

priya_enablement: Also: can we enable closed captions on recording and include timestamps for the 'dedicated capacity' segment? Helps EMEA folks.

aisha_cs: yes — we'll timestamp and add captions. Follow-up: target to finalize and send invites by EOD Friday.

nico_prod: noted. I'll draft the follow-up doc template and share by Friday noon.

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: send 2x reminder DM to participants 24h and 1h before event.

tom_solutions: If poll splits, fallback = 20:00 UTC (more global-friendly). I'll coordinate recorder.

aisha_cs: Great — closing for now. Will post final in this thread once poll closes. :white_check_mark:
